1. A pneumatic actuator, comprising:
a housing;
an actuator shaft disposed within the housing and configured to actuate between a first
position and a second position; and
a single bushing located within the housing between the housing and the actuator shaft, wherein the single bushing is configured to support the actuator shaft without the actuator shaft being supported at a second location while allowing actuator motion under set operating conditions.
2. The actuator of claim 1, wherein the actuator shaft includes a pneumatic cup at a first end, and a drive connection assembly at a second end.
3. The actuator of claim 2, wherein the bushing includes a length to diameter ratio of greater than 1.
4. The actuator of claim 3, wherein the length to diameter ratio is between 2 and 3.
5. The actuator of claim 4, wherein an inner diameter of the bushing is the same or about the same as an outer diameter of the actuator shaft.
6. The actuator of claim 5, wherein the bushing has a length of about a third of the shaft length.
7. The actuator of claim 6, further comprising a slotted crank assembly having a slot and connected to the connection assembly at the slot.
